remarks: Your wish list is fulfilled! You can truly have it all! Not one thing was missed in this custom built home! Completely maintained and improved throughout the years. This three bedroom, 2.5 bath home sits pretty on almost 5 acres overlooking the pond and wooded area. A place where quiet country meets suburbia. Tons of updates including: whole house water softener/purifier system(2026), reverse osmosis system (2026), solar panels (2014) to cover electric costs, roof (2014), central air (2026). Brand new doors throughout. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, this house has a park like setting, like no other. Enjoy fall evenings on an oversized, enclosed porch with a covered awning. During summer/spring months enjoy a kayak ride in the private pond or  enjoy evening fishing adventures. The sale includes a removable aluminum dock and two boats. Open, airy concept with large rooms and a versatile layout. Large kitchen with an island and a morning room boasting views of the serene yard. Large living room with gas fireplace. Formal dining room/library or home office. Gorgeous views of the water and wooded lot from the large morning room. Brand new glass sliding door with integrated blinds lead out to the deck. The second floor features a laundry room, bedrooms and then main bath. Primary suite includes a tremendous walk in closet/dressing area. Full basement with potential for more living space/tons of storage. Water powered back up for sump pump, 150 amp service, huge shed with concrete floor, all appliances are included. Oversized 2 car garage with additional area for workbench/storage area. Garage includes a sink and floor drain. Additional parking area for camper, RV or boat. Quiet street, well sought after location, close to both Niagara and Erie counties. This is sure to go fast, so run, don't walk.
